purpose: Bounded seed for Master Roadmap #23 — Kubera Web Design Knowledge Base / UI Resource Library.
note: This original bounded seed is preserved for lineage. The Phase 1 machine-readable registry is now the canonical expanded record for Roadmap #23.

resources.name: @sohumsuthar/liquid-glass
resources.purpose: Primary material foundation for focal glass surfaces.
resources.license: MIT (verified in installed package and repository)
resources.browserSupport: Chromium verified in Kubera lab; fallback path retained for unsupported filter behavior
resources.mobile: Use selectively; avoid many concurrent lenses
resources.accessibility: Content remains normal DOM; pair with contrast/focus states; reduced-motion CSS fallback
resources.performanceNotes: Existing V5 lab performance PASS; package documents performance gates and per-element lens cost
resources.whenToUse: Focal panels/cards where real transmission/refraction improves hierarchy
resources.whenNotToUse: Every card, dense text surfaces, or broad navigation chrome
resources.codexNotes: Already proven at 625e825…; no new dependency install in this task.

resources.name: kucukkanat/liquid-glass
resources.purpose: Reference implementation for SVG displacement, chromatic aberration, and reusable controls.
resources.browserSupport: Repository documents Safari-safe filter IDs; verify in Kubera before adoption
resources.mobile: Not adopted; requires bounded mobile testing
resources.accessibility: Native DOM controls are possible; verify focus and contrast per component
resources.performanceNotes: Repository describes map reuse and no runtime rendering dependency; no Kubera benchmark performed
resources.whenToUse: Alternative if the current foundation cannot cover a broader control kit
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not install as a second competing foundation without a measured gap

resources.name: LeonardSEO/liquid-glass-react
resources.purpose: Lightweight alternative using a single SVG feDisplacementMap path.
resources.stack: React/Next.js, CSS backdrop-filter, SVG displacement map
resources.browserSupport: Graceful blur fallback is documented; cross-browser adoption testing not performed
resources.mobile: Potentially suitable due to small runtime footprint; not adopted
resources.accessibility: Native DOM approach; must be paired with explicit focus/contrast states
resources.performanceNotes: Repository describes no WebGL/canvas and small runtime cost; no Kubera benchmark performed
resources.whenToUse: Lightweight fallback candidate when full per-element lens fidelity is unnecessary
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not replace the proven foundation without visual parity testing
